assumptions.assumption: TSA24/BC Stage A pilot supply area is a diagnostic scale, not a TSA supply estimate.
assumptions.impact: All volumes scale linearly with this value.

assumptions.assumption: Assortment matrix rows are per-hectare values; the pilot multiplies by the diagnostic area.
assumptions.impact: Base volume is area x matrix volume; no additional yield expansion.

assumptions.assumption: Roadside cost is the assortment matrix price_cad_m3 proxy, not a harvest/stumpage cost.
assumptions.impact: Changes the profit margin; transport and processing remain explicit.

assumptions.assumption: Residue volume uses the ledger 0.45 ODT/m3 basic density and 0.45 wet-basis moisture.
assumptions.impact: Residue ODT is volume x 0.45; matrix species-specific residue_odt is not used.

assumptions.assumption: Log moisture is set to the ledger green assumption because the matrix has no log moisture field.
assumptions.impact: Only relevant if a moisture blend limit is enabled.

assumptions.assumption: m3/y infeed is used directly; odt/y and bdmt/y infeed use the declared 0.45 ODT/m3 density; admt/y is rejected without a declared air-dry moisture; mbf/y is rejected without a declared recovery factor; energy units cannot become volume.
assumptions.impact: PAP bdmt/y alternatives convert below the paired m3/y log line, so product capacity is unchanged.

assumptions.assumption: Facility nameplate is the sum of the maximum normalized capacity per primary product; feedstock alternatives are not additive.
assumptions.impact: Prevents counting the same FFCM line once per feedstock alternative.

assumptions.assumption: Coordinates use a corroborated Mills DB 2015 crosswalk, then an FFCM TL/water hub proxy, then missing; exact codes alone are not trusted because the 2015 and 2018 code systems collide.
assumptions.impact: Name, city, and coordinate evidence corroborate every code match; collisions are rejected and written to the conflict table.

assumptions.assumption: Stage A scope coordinate coverage is tracked separately from all BC facilities.
assumptions.impact: Missing coordinates do not fabricate a location and do not by themselves exclude a facility from the LP.

assumptions.assumption: The TSA24 supply anchor is a geocoded Prince George mill proxy because no TSA24 FMU exists in the FFCM graph.
assumptions.impact: Anchor coordinate is Mills DB 53.99,-122.69 (FFCM BC-SAW-506, Canfor Prince George); all distances are relative to this proxy.

assumptions.assumption: Distances are FFCM route-graph shortest paths from the anchor through TL nodes, not Euclidean distances.
assumptions.impact: Median graph distance is 616.1618973962001 km versus 266.933279984 km in the previous 150 km diagnostic.

assumptions.assumption: Road and rail costs use BC transporters with archive fuel and operating rates and material capacities; transload costs are added at each TL node.
assumptions.impact: Combination paths use the actual leg mode; no global average rate is assumed.

assumptions.assumption: FFCM route capacity is absent from the parsed route table; every transport link is uncapped.
assumptions.impact: capacity=None and capacity_source=absent; do not interpret congestion or rail/water limits.

assumptions.assumption: Contracts are diagnostic: min=0 and max=facility nameplate. The BC Fibre Database contributes TSA apportionment volumes without facility IDs and residue shares without volumes, so no facility-level contract volume is inferred.
assumptions.impact: contract_source=diagnostic_absent on every contract; compliance is a bound check, not commercial evidence.

assumptions.assumption: Unassigned supply carries a diagnostic penalty so that feasible supply is not silently dropped.
assumptions.impact: The penalty is reported as a separate objective component.

assumptions.assumption: Assortment sorts are dimension-only; no BC official grade equivalence is claimed.
assumptions.impact: Grade eligibility is a feedstock-class/product screen, not a grade-quality test.

assumptions.assumption: MKRF is not used anywhere in this pilot.
assumptions.impact: No MKRF input or output is read or written.

data_gaps: no TSA24 supply-node-to-transload route in the parsed FFCM graph; a geocoded Prince George mill is the documented anchor proxy
BC coordinate recovery: 98 facilities use a corroborated Mills DB 2015 coordinate; 65 use a low-confidence TL hub proxy and 16 are missing
route capacity absent from routes.csv; all transport links use capacity=None and capacity_source=absent
BC Fibre Database has TSA apportionment volumes without facility IDs and residue allocation shares without volumes; no facility-level contract volume is available
admt/y and mbf/y capacity units require declared moisture/recovery factors and are rejected without them
no hogfuel supply in the TSA24 assortment matrix
no mill-residue (sawdust/woodchips) supply in this pilot

checks.detail: assigned + unassigned equals supply for every offer
all assignment rows reference a declared supply offer
every assignment has a declared eligible grade and transport link
no assignment exceeds a facility or grade capacity
aggregate facility assignments stay within nameplate
every unassigned row has a documented reason
facility moisture blends respect declared limits
all quantities use declared m3/odt conversions and every capacity basis is documented
every transport link declares path confidence, capacity source, and distance basis
all assignment and slack values are finite
objective decomposition reconciles to the solver objective
facility utilization rows reconcile to assignments
every contract has a compliance row
